t: This is Boy and Dolphin, a fountain in Hyde Park. It was made by Alexander Munro, a British sculptor of the Pre-Raphaelite movement. Munro concentrated on portraits and statues, and he is best known for his figure group Paolo and Francesca, from 1852, which is often seen as the epitome of Pre-Raphaelite sculpture. So as you look at this playful fountain, you're seeing the work of one of that movement's few sculptors.
